population: replay run rows with a parsed baseline answer; all items (no audit exclusion)
unit: four-arm floor-adjusted contrast vs none; raw prior − none beside
weights: item-weighted: mean over an item's parsed orders, then mean over items; 95% item bootstrap (10,000, seed 20261023 reset per estimate)
missing: fourarm_diff/lo/hi and raw_* complete cases; bound_min/bound_max = deterministic missing-outcome bounds over the SCHEDULED eligible manifest (absent jobs stay in the denominator; positive-coefficient cells' missing outcomes filled correct/wrong, negative-coefficient the reverse) — an identification range for this finite sample, not an interval; bound_items/bound_pairs = its support
support: (item, order) with all four cells eligible and parsed
